plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: Allow RoadSignal to use your location to plan routes and provide safety alerts during an active trip.
plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: Allow RoadSignal to update active-trip progress and safety alerts when the screen is locked. Location sharing stops when you end the trip.

infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: RoadSignal uses your location only for route planning, active-trip progress, and safety alerts.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: RoadSignal updates progress and safety alerts during an active trip when the screen is locked. Location sharing stops when you end the trip.
